I’m ready to deduce the structure and give you the SMILES string, but I need some experimental information about the sample first. Could you please provide any of the following data (or a brief description of the compound)?

- ¹H NMR spectrum (chemical‑shift values, multiplicities, integration)  
- ¹³C NMR spectrum (chemical‑shift values)  
- IR spectrum (key absorption bands)  
- Mass‑spectrometry data (molecular‑ion m/z and notable fragments)  
- A short description of the compound (physical state, odor, known functional groups, etc.)

With that information I can analyze the sample and supply the correct SMILES notation.
